CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2852 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95. Bus nonce: 112258ff763c8ddf52662c8bc34bb98a. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95` or `Fix review: blocked 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 112258ff763c8ddf52662c8bc34bb98a`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2852 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2852-112258ff`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA REVIEWER (opus) for PR #2852, R10-RCA-RATELIMIT-RECUR (topic r10-rca-ratelimit-recur), round 2, head 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95, bus nonce 112258ff763c8ddf52662c8bc34bb98a. Contract: dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from origin/main; review from a detached worktree at that head, with the FINDER's instruments.
PRIOR VERDICT: round 1 was BLOCKED at 23e6f7130da334347aec1dc70aefe6cdf295e4f2 (origin/verdict/2852, bus-nonce 014dc898a888928efc76e5c958f64a17): carry-missing (both forward-carries named only this PR's own group, which closes at merge) plus a finding that dev/audit/rca/ratelimit-recur.md section 3 misreports its second class rule (7 files, not 3; sweep.mjs does call gh api). Its evidence (cause attribution, per-push counts, ledger, M4 at both ends, failing-test-first and mutation proof) stood; confirm the delta did not move it (git diff 23e6f7130...HEAD on custom_components-free paths: record_row.py, tests, the record, harness).
WHAT TO CHECK:
1. The carry block. The fixer's body says no live destination exists for O-1 (R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET, which drafted it, is done; no live group names O-1, record_burst_replay or governance.yml's record job; #959 closed; no dev/programme/carries/*.json holds either item) and rewrote both carries with control and re-measurement instruction under ## Forward-carry. Verify those claims yourself at origin/main and origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (git grep the roster JSON; carry_audit.py pr 2852; check every non-done group). If a live destination exists, the block stands. If none exists, finding-propagation.md still requires the carry to sit on a stage that will act on it: decide whether the body's Forward-carry to "the seat that dispatches O-1" (an orchestrator item) is a destination the carry audit accepts and the policy accepts; if it is not, return BLOCKED with class carry-missing and name that the orchestrator must mint the destination (do not invent one). A carry text that is complete with control and re-measurement instruction but has no live roster destination is the orchestrator's decision: say so explicitly in the verdict.
2. The record's section 3 fix: re-run `git grep -l -E "describe.*--tags|--match.*v\*" -- '*.py' '*.mjs' '*.sh'` at the head and confirm the record lists every file returned (the head commit message says all seven programs with dispositions), and that sweep.mjs's gh api read (line ~136) and its CI-only --self-test disposition are stated correctly.
3. Unchanged from round 1: scope (record_row.py, its self-test, record, harness, delivery row, closures INERT), VERSION/manifest/RELEASE_NOTES/claim files untouched, merge-tree clean against current origin/main, ## Head names the head, Red checks match real check-runs (read the API, not pr checks; a RATE-LIMITED/403 red is infra).
Head and gate: the gate was not yet concluded when this was dispatched; if it is red at your read, say which check and whether it is infra. Re-read refs/pull/2852/head with git ls-remote before writing; a head that moved is a blocked verdict.
Output as the role file gives it: first line "Fix review: merge 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95" or "Fix review: blocked 6353b624ff2f3c049bc0762df0fba889f60cac95 <class>: <reason>", blank line, "bus-nonce: 112258ff763c8ddf52662c8bc34bb98a", then Block/Findings/Evidence. No Claude footers, no host paths.
